sn17.7:1.3: The construction here parallels the previous (except the opening sentence is passive). Again, I think the Buddha is quoting a well-known curse. Compare Atharva Veda 8.3.6, where Agni is called on to poison his arrow-tip and loose it at the sorcerors. Here Pali _salla_ = Sanskrit _śalya_, while Pali _diddha_ = Sanskrit _dih_.
